intent: generate; references for style and card compositing
A:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished AAA collectible-card-game UI concept board for L5R Emperor Edition. Landscape 3:2, very high resolution, impeccably legible typography. This is a UI design proposal, not a shipped game screenshot.
Input images: Image 1 is the APPROVED card-frame, inlaid token rail, navy Force ribbon and navy/gold table material reference. Image 2 is the APPROVED worn black lacquer tooltip material and typography reference. Image 3 is the actual Daidoji Kenshi card face, a compositing reference to reproduce faithfully, NOT an invitation to redesign the card. Preserve this hooded male scout art, the complete rectangular card face and its printed stats/text.
Aesthetic: deep navy woven playmat, refined fine worn-gold filigree at edges only; tactile black lacquer popovers with warm brass double rims, slight worn corners, tiny rivets. Matte ink-black interiors, ivory Caudex body lettering, bold Caudex for effect names, Caudex italic for source. Uppercase WeatheredQuill-style weathered headings with tight tracking. No olive-green boxes, generic dashboard styling, giant symbols, bright glows, neon, floating magical VFX, invented Japanese lettering or ornate clutter.
The full card face must never be covered by a status element. Preserve the narrow left black/gold token rail and deep navy right Force flag with three polished spears. Printed Force on Kenshi's face is 3; hero's current Force ribbon is 5 because the illustrated permanent bonus is +2F. Tokens, modified Force, and granted effects are distinct.
Worked example is deliberately staged: Spirit of the Berserker first gave this non-Berserker Berserker, then a later application gave +2F and a Reaction. Show all three in the expanded panel. This is illustrative future UI, not a claim this card is implemented.
Expanded tooltip exact text, with generous line spacing and clear grouping:
"PERMANENT CHANGES"
"Daidoji Kenshi"
"Berserker"
"Granted keyword · Permanent"
"+2 Force"
"Stat bonus · Permanent"
"Granted Reaction · Permanent"
"After another player's action targets this Personality: Delay his destruction from the action's effects until before this turn ends."
"Source: Spirit of the Berserker"
Source is an elegant small underlined hoverable name, not a raw ID. The wording 'before this turn ends' belongs to the Reaction effect and must NOT be presented as the duration of the permanent grant.
All detail is revealed on hover or keyboard focus, no accept/confirm/continue buttons, no action buttons inside tooltip. Temporary changes would be in their own duration-labeled section rather than marked with a permanent seal; do not invent temporary card effects here.
Composition: top header at 5% height; large hero comparison of one card on left and a spacious tooltip on right occupies roughly upper two-thirds. The tooltip has enough space for every word without clipping. Across bottom, three smaller clearly separated detail examples: a single grant at rest; the marker alongside an occupied existing token rail; and a sideways bowed card with the same marker. Cards retain correct aspect ratios. Bottom examples are enlarged UX detail crops with clear captions, not tiny illegible thumbnails. Footer exact: "Concept only · illustrative grants".
Avoid redundant instructional paragraphs; short annotation captions and clean leader lines outside card art are sufficient. Most visual real estate goes to the actual card and readable tooltip.
VARIANT A — ENDURING SEAL.
Header exact: "A · ENDURING SEAL".
Use a small refined brass endless-knot/infinity emblem seated flush in the TOP CAP of the existing LEFT black lacquer token rail. The icon represents permanence, not a Japanese character or a wax blob. One discrete seal per card aggregates all permanent changes; a tiny plain ivory numeral 3 beside the seal in the rail cap indicates three changes. This count is visually separate from token quantities. The icon should feel manufactured into the approved rail, without extending its width. It must NOT overlap the card name or top-left printed Force.
On hover, the seal's rim warms slightly and the large black lacquer tooltip opens next to the card. Give the tooltip the exact restrained materials from image 2. Fine gold dividers between the three changes, all source names readable.
Bottom captions exact: "One grant", "Tokens remain separate", "Bowed with the card". In One grant, show seal without 3; Tokens remain separate shows the seal in the upper cap and three actual small counters BELOW it, retaining the approved rail dimensions. Bowed example rotates the physical card and rail as a single unit.
Small subtitle: "A quiet marker. Full context on hover."

VARIANT B — INSCRIBED EDGE.
Header exact: "B · INSCRIBED EDGE".
Unlike variant A's tiny aggregate seal, mount a VERY SLIM worn black lacquer status strip immediately BELOW the outer BOTTOM edge of the full card, in the space outside the print. Warm worn brass trim, refined engraved infinity pictogram at the left. Clearly separate this strip from the existing token rail on the left and the Force ribbon on the right. It gives immediate readable at-rest information, without covering the card art or adding a sidebar.
For the hero with three changes, strip text exact: "∞ Berserker · +2F · Reaction". Use ivory Caudex in a readable compact size, never all-caps body text. Strip is no wider than the card; no button styling or quantity controls. For one permanent keyword, it simply says "∞ Berserker". A full card hover/focus opens the same complete black-lacquer effects panel on the right, with three spacious sections and source information. The attached strip and tooltip feel physically made of the same lacquer and aged brass.
Bottom captions exact: "Readable at rest", "Several changes", "Bowed with the card". Show one-keyword strip in first detail, the three-change strip plus occupied left token rail in second; in third the card rotates sideways together with its strip, and the hover tooltip remains upright off-card. No stacking multiple thick strips; one slim line or concise "∞ 3 changes" at smaller zoom preserves space.
Small subtitle: "See the change before you inspect."

CRITICAL bowed detail: The lower-right card must be rotated EXACTLY 90 degrees clockwise, entirely sideways, with the title running vertically along its right edge. Do not depict a merely tilted upright card. Fit a whole landscape silhouette in that lower detail box. Strip rotates with the card, appearing along the left edge after clockwise rotation. Leave its caption horizontal. Preserve the hero card upright.

Keep EVERY OTHER part of the concept unchanged: all large hero card imagery, gold rail and seal, three-change tooltip and exact reaction/source text, top header, background textures and frame, lower-left and lower-middle examples and their captions, full image size and composition. Do not redesign, reflow, recolor, change typography or add new UI. Preserve the approved worn black lacquer and gold material.

REMOVE the UPRIGHT VERTICAL navy flag with upright spear icons at the extreme right edge of this small inset. status: Concepts for user review only. No game implementation or rules changes.
rules_context: Spirit of the Berserker uses current local Oracle reference text. The catalogue marks it unsupported and needs_era_review. Illustrates two successive applications: first grants Berserker; later grants +2F and a permanent Reaction. Exact period printing and rules-lead review remain implementation gates. Core currently exposes granted keywords; full granted ability text/source transport still needs shared work.
references_note: Token/art examples are illustrative visual stress states, not claimed legal combinations.
